proposal.summary: MXsecurity versions prior to 1.0.1 contain an authentication bypass when the web service authenticator uses insufficiently random values, allowing a remote attacker to access the system.

AV.quote: A remote attacker might access the system

PR.quote: A remote attacker might access the system

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request or obtain a proof-of-concept or detailed technical description showing how insufficient randomness is exploited, and determine whether credentials or sessions can be fully impersonated; if confirmed, coordinate disclosure and advise immediate upgrade to 1.0.1 or apply mitigation (improve randomness source).
